review.gallery: Eight original brochure renders and a dated October 2026 developer construction photograph.
review.location: The official brochure identifies District 2 and marks the project near E311. JRE provides the approximate pin. Fifteen driving estimates match the regional map panel.
review.floorPlans: Nine complete drawings from the direct Ellington floor and amenity packs. The dedicated plan pack and project brief label the typical plate 2–7. The brochure illustration uses 2–5, which is kept as a source edition difference. The printed 1 BR Type B total is 812.68 sq ft against 812.67 from the components.

unavailable: Surveyed entrance, separate podium parking floor plans, every unit-specific area variation and verified completed photography.
